messages:
Rina C: Quick review: proposing a sidebar reorg where we surface three persistent groups (Explore / Registry / Admin). Goal: simpler permalinks and fewer nested clicks. Figma: https://figma.com/s/sidebar-reorg-v1. Feedback?

Devon M: Love the groups. Question about permalink contract: do we want canonical URLs that reflect groups as path segments (`/p/:id/registry/models`) or prefer query params? Path segments are cleaner for sharing and analytics.

Ola S: Path segments + hyphenated slugs please. Also recommend a breadcrumb policy: show `Projects / <Project> / <Group> / <Page>` and collapse the middle crumbs into an accessible menu on small screens.

Marco V: Implementation note: we should canonicalize legacy `#group=` and `?group=` links on load with `history.replaceState` so old links don't 404. Emit a telemetry event when we normalize.

a11y-bot: Accessibility nits: 1) set focus to H1 on deep-link load, 2) ensure `aria-current=\"page\"` on active sidebar item, 3) add `role=\"navigation\" aria-label=\"Primary navigation\"`, 4) provide a visible skip link to `#main-content`.

QA-Jen: Test cases: deep-link load focus, back/forward behavior after replaceState, mobile crumb collapse menu keyboard operability, and analytics dedupe when both legacy+canonical hit.

Rina C: Copy tweak: prefer \"Model Registry\" in full nav; display as \"Registry\" in crumbs and collapsed nav. Root crumb label = \"Projects\" (not Workspace).

Devon M: Collapse state: persist in sessionStorage only. If product wants collapse in URL, expose via fragment only (`#collapsed=true`) and keep it non-canonical.

Ola S: Breadcrumb truncation: on overflow show `Projects / … / Registry / Versions` with an accessible list to expand hidden crumbs. Ensure the menu is reachable by keyboard and announced to screen readers.

Marco V: Action items: I'll draft the router change and legacy parser PR. Rina update Figma + final copy. QA-Jen add e2e. Ola will add accessibility checklist to the ticket.

Rina C: Thanks team 389 I'll post the revised screens and the permalink spec here when ready.
